stage: Bench and boards — delivered by the electrical build
when: Before this project starts — the ICU, the DCU and their firmware are the electrical build's (electrical D-374)
prerequisites: none of this project's - the electrical build's stage F
outcome: Both modules built, flashed and in the car with the harness; this project starts with them already there

stage: ICU and display — delivered by the electrical build
when: Before this project starts — the ICU and its display are built, bench-commissioned and installed with the harness (electrical D-259, D-268)
prerequisites: none of this project's — the electrical build's install §1.20–1.24 and §5, and MG22
plugs_into: DP-ICU-A · DP-ICU-B — the electrical build's, live from install
outcome: Every sensor read once at the ICU and on CAN2; the display is the car's instrument on a plain plate; this project starts with both already in the car

stage: Climate — blower, servos, the panel's faceplate
prerequisites: Electrical finished (01-electrical E34): the DCU and panel electronics, the O15 comfort block and comfort-return harness, the servo leads, and the hatch and fuel-door releases are all electrical's (D-450). This stage brings the blower motor + final stage, the servos and the faceplate (LP20)
plugs_into: L3-BLW · L3-P 2 · the DCU's comfort receptacle (electrical P153) · the DCU's servo headers · O4 enable · L4-M 3 / 4
outcome: Heat, defrost and ventilation return; rear defog; hatch and fuel-door keys; cabin and outside temperature on the bus

stage: Display bezel — the dash plastics around the display
prerequisites: the display in the car on its plate (electrical D-268); M-1's aperture measurements (electrical C1); the plate stays as the sub-frame (electrical D-269)
plugs_into: nothing at the harness and nothing at the ICU — the ribbon and the button are as they were
outcome: A moulded bezel (foam plug, fibreglass skin, finish) integrating the display; the bare plate disappears

when: When the carpet comes up for sound deadening
prerequisites: Electrical finished: the under-seat feeds (01-electrical A14, D-450); S2 done
outcome: Heated and cooled seats, sound deadening (the heated nozzle and park de-icer are cancelled — D-329)

prerequisites: Electrical finished: the door harness to the mirrors (01-electrical A12) and the F14 fuse fitted (D-450); W-332 (the mirrors' pin-out and currents); a bonded resistive heat pad per glass (D-332)
plugs_into: D1 / D2 4-7 · DP-DCU 19-22 (the DCU tail, electrical D-472) → L4-S2 1-5 · L4-P 4 → F14

when: Door cards off — pair with S5
prerequisites: Electrical finished: the door harness to the window motors, K5-K8 and F8 / F9 fitted (01-electrical A12, D-450); regulators and motors sourced; the window keys are panel keys (LP20, D-355)
plugs_into: D1 / D2 1-2 · K5-K8 · F8 / F9 · DP-DCU 15-18 (the DCU tail, electrical D-472) → L4-M 9-12 · L4-P 3

prerequisites: V-063, V-064, V-066 (sizes the headlamp plates, D-358)
plugs_into: the existing lamp sockets and channels
outcome: Custom tail lights, DOT headlamp units, LED bulbs; every lamp soft fuse re-set (D-122)

when: After the detector is picked (X-014) and the bumper design places its windows (the bumper design (block 04.13))
prerequisites: D-508 design; the pick (X-014); the bumper design (block 04.13) for the sensor windows; electrical finished: the runs L2-RDR and L4-HRD installed (01-electrical E40) and the adapter leads A20
plugs_into: L2-RDR (nose) · L4-HRD (hatch, via the L3-S3 1-3 ↔ L4-S 5-7 pass-through) · N103 at the dash · SN30 (J12) on the DCU
outcome: Concealed front and rear sensors, the module behind the dash, the DCU reading the alert and the cluster showing it (0x320)

stage: Audio - head unit, upmix, amplifier, 5.1 speakers and the sub
when: Interior out: kick panels, rear quarter trims and the driver-side bin open; after the battery is in the passenger-side bin (electrical V-088)
plastics: yes - kick panels, rear quarter trims, the driver-side bin, the console between the seats
prerequisites: Block 03.13 answered; the measurements V-103 to V-110; electrical finished: the head unit's four feeds, the amplifier's fused feed in the passenger-side bin, pre-amp cable and speaker cable to every position (01-electrical A17, D-450)
plugs_into: L3-M 1 / L3-M 2 / L3-S1 8 at the head unit; electrical's amplifier feed, pre-amp cable and speaker plugs (01-electrical A17)
outcome: A 5.1 system from a flat head unit: front, centre, surrounds and sub, upmixed from stereo, amplified on its own feed

stage: Body and paint - rust repair, the reshaped body, the paint and the tint
when: Car off the road at a body shop or in the garage, after the electrical build; the trim comes off once (C02) and goes back with the interior (S11)
prerequisites: B02 the rust and body survey; C02 to C10 the design rows; D-475, D-527 the routes and the colour
plugs_into: nothing electrical beyond the lamps (S7) and the radar windows (S8)
outcome: A rust-free, reshaped body in Dark Metallic Emerald Green, seamless, tinted to the Colorado limits

stage: Interior trim - every plastic custom-made, black leather with green stitching
when: Interior out, with S2, S3 and S9 (the plastics events) and the door cards of S5 / S6; after the paint so nothing is masked twice
plastics: every cabin plastic: dash, binnacle, centre stack, console, door cards, kick panels, quarter, pillar and hatch trims
prerequisites: X-015 the trim plan; X-016 the upholstery round; the stages whose plastics it replaces
plugs_into: the mounting points of the factory trim, and whatever S2, S3, S5, S6 and S9 put through it
outcome: One sleek, seamless cabin: every trim piece new and skinned in black leather with green stitching (D-571)
